ACTION_AUTHORITY.principle: result SCENE visible != result COMMITTED. MEDIUM authority: advance requires fresh RESULT identity + no protected choice + bounded cycle; commit requires explicit evidence.
ACTION_AUTHORITY.advance: authorized after explicit result evidence captured (or classified UNKNOWN and preserved)
ACTION_AUTHORITY.animation_center_tap: clicks during unfinished animation were observed NO_EFFECT — wait then tap
ACTION_AUTHORITY.commit_authority: perception never commits; the executor commits only EXPLICIT_PASS/EXPLICIT_FAIL classes; UNKNOWN cannot commit progress

ALLOWED_ACTIONS: bounded advance cycle (SKIP → textbox → center) after capture
FORBIDDEN_ACTIONS: committing completion flags from derived expectation (POST_TRANSACTION_STATE_MUST_BE_RECONCILED_FROM_FRESH_STABLE_STATE)

POSTCONDITIONS.audition_pass: flag committed true; fan delta observable on fresh HOME
POSTCONDITIONS.audition_fail: flag stays false; week consumed; retry/replan from fresh state
POSTCONDITIONS.unknown: flag stays false; advance proceeds but result remains UNKNOWN

EXIT_CONDITIONS: advance cycle → fresh WING_HOME / season transition / next result state

FAILURE_MODES.evidence: S3_40K first attempt + S3 semifinal scene

RECOVERY: evidence lost → result stays UNKNOWN, flag uncommitted; never infer WIN from subsequent scene labels
